newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian bourse locked in static trade.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian bourse locked in static trade.

text.p: Lithuania's drowsy bourse remained quiet on Tuesday but dealers said activity should increase as companies get set to report their 1996 earnings.
The group A index slipped by 28.78 points to 2,377.52 in light central market trade of 1.07 million litas.
"This is a seasonal trend that happens every year. Everyone is waiting for the shareholders' meetings in March," one dealer said. "Things will become more active after that."
"It's the calm after the January boom," said another in reference to last month's bull-run.
"Prices are relatively low now but so is demand," he added.
Despite the index set-back, some leading blue chip stocks made impressive gains, albeit in light trade.
Birzai Milk rose 10 percent to 8.80 litas in trade of almost 119,000 litas and the Lithuania Sea Shipping Company advanced to 12.50 litas from 12.00 litas in trade worth 2,600 litas.
Hermis Bank climbed to 200 litas from 199 litas in trade of 42,600 litas.

Losers included Metal Commerce, which saw its price decline to 0.40 litas from 0.44 litas in trade of only 137.00 litas. Rokishkis Cheese fell to 46.00 litas from 45.00 litas in trade of 76,000 litas. Block trades amounted to 956,000 litas.
